purpose: Fictional football grades for all386 standard-form Pokemon, hidden during drafts and revealed only after Hall of Fame induction. Static frontend code remains inspectable. These are game judgments, not official Pokemon or NFL statistics.
physicalSource: The bundled dist/assets/pokemon.js catalog supplies standard-form heightMeters and weightKg from the sourced species data, and the existing hand-estimated fortySeconds value. Scouting traits below are editorial game judgments, not official Pokémon statistics.
lorePolicy: Familiar canonical Pokedex characteristics, learnable moves across generations, standard abilities and explicitly identified canonical animation depictions inspire fictional football mechanics. No free injuries, automatic wins, unlimited time travel or perfect Transform copying. Displayed forty estimates are untouched.

model.physicalBaseline: Reviewed species strength, durability, mobility, awareness and control plus actual heightMeters, weightKg and estimated fortySeconds; positional weights in dist/ratings.js. DE now emphasizes movement/burst/reads53% before lore fit.
model.loreFit: 386 individually authored profiles assign mechanism-specific role fits. Explicit anchors weigh70%, physical/anatomical baseline30%, with maximum3-point elite fit synergy. Unanchored responsibilities retain the species-specific baseline and all anatomical constraints.
model.ballControl: Actual hands, tentacles, vines, tail hands, tongues, trunks, cannon loading or established Psychic can control a ball. A Pokemon type alone never grants control. Spheres, cocoons, ordinary fish, molten bodies and individual Unown have explicit severe possession caps; blades can deflect better than they can safely retain.
model.speed: Existing estimated40 contributes to baseline; Teleport, burrowing, flight, ghost feints and Rapid Spin alter role fit independently of that displayed straight-line estimate.
model.symmetry: LT/RT and LG/RG share baseline/OL fits; ILB/MLB share inside responsibilities. CB fits extend to NB/DB, LB fits to six linebacker roles; more-specific anchors then override family fits.
model.xFactor: Species lore factor0..1 is reduced by role fit and final grade; engine uses it only for modest bounded occasional advantages. Grades remain the primary strength.
model.explanations: explain(id,role) combines distinct species lore/mechanic rationale and that position's responsibility; UI must call only for Hall of Fame-inducted Pokemon.

species.rationale: Pressure and Frisk help Dusclops identify threats, and its hollow suction-like body and hands can trap a close football; exceptional durability supports traffic tackling, not automatic possession or deep coverage speed.
species.synopsis: Dusclops can trap the ball with large hands and withstand traffic around the line. Its deliberate movement rewards patient reads but leaves it vulnerable to sharp cuts and deep speed.

species.name: Tropius

species.rationale: Fly gives Tropius a high catch point and its long neck can help shield a mouth-held ball; Harvest supports stamina flavor, not healing every snap, while large leaf wings and a quadruped stance restrict passing and sharp routes.
species.synopsis: Tropius uses leaf-wing flight and a long neck to reach over smaller defenders. Its broad turns and mouth-based possession make quick routes and precision passing unreliable.

species.name: Chimecho
species.canonicalInspiredRationale: Chimecho communicates with resonating cries and uses Psychic or Telekinesis to guide possession, creating a composed distributor and deep-field organizer; a one-kilogram body cannot stop a charging blocker or absorb sustained hits.

species.rationale: Chimecho communicates with resonating cries and uses Psychic or Telekinesis to guide possession, creating a composed distributor and deep-field organizer; a one-kilogram body cannot stop a charging blocker or absorb sustained hits.
species.synopsis: Chimecho coordinates coverage through its resonating calls and guides the ball with psychic precision. Its tiny floating frame excels at reading space but struggles with every heavy collision.

species.name: Absol
species.canonicalInspiredRationale: Absol detects impending disasters, inspiring exceptional route anticipation and early jumps on a pass; Super Luck adds bounded turnover variance and feints suit shifty edge work, while its scythe and paws do not provide hand-like catches.

species.synopsis: Absol anticipates trouble before it develops and attacks lanes with quick, evasive movement. Mouth-based possession limits its catch radius and passing despite outstanding defensive instincts.

species.name: Wynaut
species.canonicalInspiredRationale: Counter and Mirror Coat inspire timed resistance when contact arrives, while Shadow Tag can shade a nearby lane; neither creates a throwing motion, an unbreakable tackle or the speed to follow receivers across the field.
species.physicalScoutingNote: Small arm-like flaps permit a limited grasp; a reactive body and slow feet undermine proactive football tasks.
species.rationale: Counter and Mirror Coat inspire timed resistance when contact arrives, while Shadow Tag can shade a nearby lane; neither creates a throwing motion, an unbreakable tackle or the speed to follow receivers across the field.
species.synopsis: Wynaut can brace for contact and react to an opponent near its spot. Slow feet, short limbs and a reactive style make passing and active coverage difficult.

species.name: Snorunt
species.canonicalInspiredRationale: Inner Focus supports concentration and Ice Shard suggests useful timing, but Snorunt's short hands and feet have limited reach; icy conditions are not assumed for route acceleration or an Ice Body recovery advantage.
species.physicalScoutingNote: Small hands can attempt possession under a broad cone, but its short frame and awkward reach limit football control.
species.rationale: Inner Focus supports concentration and Ice Shard suggests useful timing, but Snorunt's short hands and feet have limited reach; icy conditions are not assumed for route acceleration or an Ice Body recovery advantage.
species.synopsis: Snorunt stays focused and can make simple catches with its small hands. Short reach and an awkward cone-shaped frame limit contact strength, passing leverage and separation.

species.name: Glalie
species.canonicalInspiredRationale: Inner Focus and a hard icy shell make Glalie a composed short-area disruptor; its huge jaw can retain a ball but its spherical body lacks arms for snaps and cannot gain free possession by freezing the football.
species.physicalScoutingNote: A massive floating ice head can ram and bite-carry, but has neither hands nor a dependable throwing release.
species.rationale: Inner Focus and a hard icy shell make Glalie a composed short-area disruptor; its huge jaw can retain a ball but its spherical body lacks arms for snaps and cannot gain free possession by freezing the football.
species.synopsis: Glalie brings a hard shell and a heavy hovering body to short-area collisions. Its jaw can carry the ball, but a lack of limbs restricts catching range, snaps and throwing.

species.name: Spheal
species.canonicalInspiredRationale: Thick Fat cushions a short collision and rolling movement can push through a small opening; flippers cannot make a reliable spiral and a mouth-held ball makes balanced rolling and catching harder.
species.physicalScoutingNote: A rolling seal with cushioning blubber and tiny flippers, offering little independent ball manipulation.
species.rationale: Thick Fat cushions a short collision and rolling movement can push through a small opening; flippers cannot make a reliable spiral and a mouth-held ball makes balanced rolling and catching harder.
species.synopsis: Spheal can absorb a bump and roll through a short opening. Tiny flippers, a round body and mouth-based possession make controlled routes and passing very difficult.

species.name: Sealeo
species.canonicalInspiredRationale: Sealeo balances objects on its nose, suggesting better nearby ball tracking than Spheal, and Thick Fat supports traffic resistance; balancing a ball does not equal a secure catch under contact or a forward throwing grip.
species.physicalScoutingNote: A sturdy seal with practiced nose balance, useful contact mass and limited flipper or mouth possession.
species.rationale: Sealeo balances objects on its nose, suggesting better nearby ball tracking than Spheal, and Thick Fat supports traffic resistance; balancing a ball does not equal a secure catch under contact or a forward throwing grip.
species.synopsis: Sealeo tracks nearby objects well and can use its bulky body to absorb contact. Flipper movement and unsecured nose balancing limit reliable routes, catches and passing.

species.name: Walrein
species.canonicalInspiredRationale: Walrein's tusks and crushing strength can hold a gap while Thick Fat supports collision resistance; its mouth can carry a football carefully, but tusks obstruct the catch window and flippers cannot execute a normal snap or pass.
species.physicalScoutingNote: A heavy tusked seal with strong shoulders and thick blubber, but no hands and poor lateral land recovery.
species.rationale: Walrein's tusks and crushing strength can hold a gap while Thick Fat supports collision resistance; its mouth can carry a football carefully, but tusks obstruct the catch window and flippers cannot execute a normal snap or pass.
species.synopsis: Walrein fills a gap with heavy shoulders, tusks and a thick protective body. Slow land recovery and a restricted mouth catch make it much better suited to contact than ball movement.

species.name: Clamperl
species.canonicalInspiredRationale: Shell Armor and Iron Defense allow a stubborn stationary obstacle, but opening the shell is not a safe independent football catch; the small inner body cannot snap, pursue or release a pass.
species.physicalScoutingNote: A heavy armored clam with a clamping shell, no throwing limbs and effectively no field mobility.
species.rationale: Shell Armor and Iron Defense allow a stubborn stationary obstacle, but opening the shell is not a safe independent football catch; the small inner body cannot snap, pursue or release a pass.
species.synopsis: Clamperl can brace behind a hard shell and resist a close collision. Without limbs or a usable land gait, it cannot reliably handle the ball or cover space.

species.name: Huntail
species.canonicalInspiredRationale: Huntail's powerful jaws and deceptive tail lure inspire short-range baiting and a clamp tackle; its deep-water swimming anatomy cannot turn water-based burst into turf pursuit or a precise pass release.
species.physicalScoutingNote: A strong-jawed eel can trap possession in its mouth or coils but struggles to move or turn on land.
species.rationale: Huntail's powerful jaws and deceptive tail lure inspire short-range baiting and a clamp tackle; its deep-water swimming anatomy cannot turn water-based burst into turf pursuit or a precise pass release.
species.synopsis: Huntail can lure a nearby opponent and clamp down with powerful jaws. Its aquatic body struggles on turf, and mouth or coil possession offers little passing or receiving precision.

species.name: Gorebyss
species.canonicalInspiredRationale: Psychic and Confusion give Gorebyss a real telekinetic catch and controlled short release, unlike ordinary fish; its sucking mouth and swimming fins do not provide levitation or stable land footwork, keeping mobile football roles weak.
species.physicalScoutingNote: Psychic control can grasp a ball independently of its narrow mouth, but the aquatic body remains nearly immobile on turf.
species.rationale: Psychic and Confusion give Gorebyss a real telekinetic catch and controlled short release, unlike ordinary fish; its sucking mouth and swimming fins do not provide levitation or stable land footwork, keeping mobile football roles weak.
species.synopsis: Gorebyss can use psychic control to catch or release a nearby football without hands. Its aquatic body still moves poorly on turf and cannot follow receivers or reset the pocket quickly.

species.name: Relicanth
species.canonicalInspiredRationale: Rock Head and Sturdy support an unusually tough stationary collision, yet Relicanth's unchanged deep-sea anatomy leaves it unable to pursue; a small mouth and fins constrain receiving and passing regardless of swimming strength.
species.physicalScoutingNote: A stone-hard fish resists contact but has no useful land gait or fine ball manipulation.
species.rationale: Rock Head and Sturdy support an unusually tough stationary collision, yet Relicanth's unchanged deep-sea anatomy leaves it unable to pursue; a small mouth and fins constrain receiving and passing regardless of swimming strength.
species.synopsis: Relicanth can withstand a hard collision with its stone-like body. Fins, a limited mouth grip and poor turf movement prevent that durability from translating into active coverage or ball handling.

species.name: Luvdisc
species.canonicalInspiredRationale: Swift Swim and Agility describe aquatic movement rather than a dry-field route; its small mouth cannot retain a full football under contact, and charm is bounded deception rather than automatic control of an opponent.
species.physicalScoutingNote: A thin heart-shaped fish with no grasping limbs, dependable football mouth grip or land stride.
species.rationale: Swift Swim and Agility describe aquatic movement rather than a dry-field route; its small mouth cannot retain a full football under contact, and charm is bounded deception rather than automatic control of an opponent.
species.synopsis: Luvdisc is agile in water but lacks a practical way to run or secure a football on turf. Its small frame and limited mouth grip also leave it vulnerable in contact.

species.name: Bagon
species.canonicalInspiredRationale: Rock Head and its habit of charging into rocks suggest fearless lead contact and edge leverage; small arms permit a cradle catch, but Bagon's obsession with flight does not grant wings, polished reads or a strong throwing motion.
species.physicalScoutingNote: A compact biped with small arms and a rock-hard head, useful for contact but limited in reach and release.
species.rationale: Rock Head and its habit of charging into rocks suggest fearless lead contact and edge leverage; small arms permit a cradle catch, but Bagon's obsession with flight does not grant wings, polished reads or a strong throwing motion.
species.synopsis: Bagon attacks contact fearlessly with a rock-hard head and a compact body. Small arms, short reach and raw decision-making limit its passing and receiving polish.

species.name: Shelgon
species.canonicalInspiredRationale: Overcoat and its sturdy shell support surviving traffic and occupying a gap, but Shelgon's encased developing limbs cannot make a useful snap or catch; Rock Head does not compensate for slow turns and a restricted release.
species.physicalScoutingNote: A dense protective shell and limited exposed limbs favor gap resistance over ball control and open-field movement.
species.rationale: Overcoat and its sturdy shell support surviving traffic and occupying a gap, but Shelgon's encased developing limbs cannot make a useful snap or catch; Rock Head does not compensate for slow turns and a restricted release.
species.synopsis: Shelgon can absorb punishment and occupy a gap behind its dense shell. Restricted limbs and slow turning make ball handling and open-field pursuit difficult.

species.name: Salamence
species.canonicalInspiredRationale: Intimidate and forceful flight create a terrifying wide-angle rush, while claws, jaws and strong wings support contested possession; Moxie inspires bounded momentum, not an unlimited power chain, and quadrupedal anatomy limits precise passing.
species.physicalScoutingNote: A powerful winged quadruped with a usable mouth catch and claw-assisted possession, but limited precision passing mechanics.
species.rationale: Intimidate and forceful flight create a terrifying wide-angle rush, while claws, jaws and strong wings support contested possession; Moxie inspires bounded momentum, not an unlimited power chain, and quadrupedal anatomy limits precise passing.
species.synopsis: Salamence attacks the edge with powerful flight and can contest high throws with claws and jaws. Broad wings and a quadrupedal stance make precise passing and tight-space footwork less natural.

species.name: Beldum
species.canonicalInspiredRationale: Beldum communicates magnetically and drives its steel body into a target, making a narrow collision specialist; its single clawed appendage does not inherit Metang's Psychic control or Metagross's supercomputer reads.
species.physicalScoutingNote: A floating iron limb with talons and magnetic signaling, but no dependable two-sided grasp or accurate release.
species.rationale: Beldum communicates magnetically and drives its steel body into a target, making a narrow collision specialist; its single clawed appendage does not inherit Metang's Psychic control or Metagross's supercomputer reads.
species.synopsis: Beldum can float into a collision and resist contact with its iron body. A single clawed appendage and limited coordination make catching, throwing and complex coverage difficult.

species.name: Metang
species.canonicalInspiredRationale: Two linked brains improve processing, Psychic supplies precise ball manipulation and steel claws can redirect blockers; Bullet Punch timing inspires a quick first hand strike, but dense weight still limits repeated coverage cuts.
species.physicalScoutingNote: Linked brains, grasping steel arms and psychic control combine reliable possession with a strong floating contact base.
species.rationale: Two linked brains improve processing, Psychic supplies precise ball manipulation and steel claws can redirect blockers; Bullet Punch timing inspires a quick first hand strike, but dense weight still limits repeated coverage cuts.
species.synopsis: Metang pairs linked-brain awareness with steel arms and psychic control for reliable possession and protection. Its dense body handles contact well but struggles to mirror fast changes of direction.

species.name: Metagross
species.canonicalInspiredRationale: Four linked brains process like a supercomputer while four steel limbs and Psychic simultaneously protect, snap and control the ball; Meteor Mash and Hammer Arm inspire powerful trench strikes, but its wide heavy base is less natural for receiver breaks and corner mirroring.
species.physicalScoutingNote: Four coordinated steel limbs and supercomputer processing create unmatched contact control and reads, with only moderate fluid coverage.
species.rationale: Four linked brains process like a supercomputer while four steel limbs and Psychic simultaneously protect, snap and control the ball; Meteor Mash and Hammer Arm inspire powerful trench strikes, but its wide heavy base is less natural for receiver breaks and corner mirroring.
species.synopsis: Metagross reads the field like a supercomputer and controls contact with four powerful steel limbs plus telekinesis. Its wide, heavy frame favors coordinated protection and interior defense over sharp receiver cuts.

species.name: Regirock
species.canonicalInspiredRationale: Regirock repairs its rock body and uses Sturdy to support repeated trench contact, while Lock-On inspires disciplined target identification; Hammer Arm supplies force but neither unbreakable protection nor smooth hand dexterity for passing.
species.physicalScoutingNote: Enormously durable stone arms and a massive base create a trench anchor, with rigid ball control and slow recovery.
species.rationale: Regirock repairs its rock body and uses Sturdy to support repeated trench contact, while Lock-On inspires disciplined target identification; Hammer Arm supplies force but neither unbreakable protection nor smooth hand dexterity for passing.
species.synopsis: Regirock anchors the line with massive stone arms and exceptional resistance to contact. Rigid joints and slow recovery make fine possession and open-field coverage difficult.

species.name: Regice
species.canonicalInspiredRationale: Lock-On supports controlled targeting and Regice's ancient ice body resists punishment; it can reach with physical arms, but an ice beam is not a football cannon and rigid extremities restrict secure catches and release touch.
species.physicalScoutingNote: A stable ice body and long rigid arms resist pressure, but narrow hands and limited traction reduce dexterity and lateral range.
species.rationale: Lock-On supports controlled targeting and Regice's ancient ice body resists punishment; it can reach with physical arms, but an ice beam is not a football cannon and rigid extremities restrict secure catches and release touch.
species.synopsis: Regice holds its ground with a resilient body and disciplined targeting. Rigid extremities and limited traction reduce its receiving touch, release mechanics and lateral coverage.

species.name: Registeel
species.canonicalInspiredRationale: Registeel's unusually flexible metal body and functional fingers support hand placement, snaps and short catches, while Clear Body and Iron Defense inspire pocket stability; extreme durability does not create deep speed or sophisticated quarterback touch.
species.physicalScoutingNote: Flexible metal arms, firm hands and a resilient shell support protection and possession, with slow open-field feet.
species.rationale: Registeel's unusually flexible metal body and functional fingers support hand placement, snaps and short catches, while Clear Body and Iron Defense inspire pocket stability; extreme durability does not create deep speed or sophisticated quarterback touch.
species.synopsis: Registeel combines flexible metal limbs with a nearly unyielding body for controlled blocking and interior defense. Slow acceleration limits routes and coverage even when its hands can secure the ball.

species.name: Latias
species.canonicalInspiredRationale: Latias reads emotions, communicates telepathically and refracts light to obscure itself, creating deceptive routes and coordinated deep coverage; Telekinesis makes catches feasible, but camouflage does not hide the football or remove contact costs.

species.rationale: Latias reads emotions, communicates telepathically and refracts light to obscure itself, creating deceptive routes and coordinated deep coverage; Telekinesis makes catches feasible, but camouflage does not hide the football or remove contact costs.
species.synopsis: Latias combines telepathic reads, fast flight and psychic catches to patrol deep space or disguise a route. A relatively light body struggles to anchor sustained contact against heavy blockers.

species.name: Latios
species.canonicalInspiredRationale: Latios understands human speech, shares mental images through sight-sharing lore and uses Telekinesis for precise football release; fast flight and Luster Purge timing support separation, but a flight-oriented body lacks an interior anchor's leverage.
species.physicalScoutingNote: Jet-like flight, keen intelligence and precise psychic release combine field vision and separation, with limited stationary blocking base.
species.rationale: Latios understands human speech, shares mental images through sight-sharing lore and uses Telekinesis for precise football release; fast flight and Luster Purge timing support separation, but a flight-oriented body lacks an interior anchor's leverage.
species.synopsis: Latios shares information mentally and delivers precise psychic passes while threatening space with fast flight. Its flight-oriented frame offers much less leverage in a planted blocking contest.

species.name: Kyogre
species.canonicalInspiredRationale: Kyogre's enormous bulk and Drizzle-inspired composure can crowd an interior lane, but rain does not create a swimming field; fins and a narrow mouth do not become a football cannon merely because Hydro Pump is powerful.
species.physicalScoutingNote: A tremendously powerful marine body offers mass and reach but lacks hands, a stable turf gait or reliable release mechanics.
species.rationale: Kyogre's enormous bulk and Drizzle-inspired composure can crowd an interior lane, but rain does not create a swimming field; fins and a narrow mouth do not become a football cannon merely because Hydro Pump is powerful.
species.synopsis: Kyogre can occupy an enormous amount of space and withstand contact. Fins, poor turf movement and limited mouth control keep that power from solving passing, receiving or pursuit.

species.name: Groudon
species.canonicalInspiredRationale: Groudon's massive plated frame and Hammer Arm force make extraordinary gap control and lead blocking plausible; Drought does not erase its huge turning radius, and short clawed hands limit delicate passing despite overwhelming strength.
species.physicalScoutingNote: A colossal armored biped with usable claws and unmatched pushing mass, but broad turns and modest release finesse.
species.rationale: Groudon's massive plated frame and Hammer Arm force make extraordinary gap control and lead blocking plausible; Drought does not erase its huge turning radius, and short clawed hands limit delicate passing despite overwhelming strength.

species.name: Rayquaza
species.canonicalInspiredRationale: Rayquaza's high-altitude flight and Air Lock support clean aerial tracking while its short grasping arms can high-point a football; long-body rush angles and coiling wraps are dangerous, but vast reach does not guarantee precise spirals or compact corner cuts.
species.physicalScoutingNote: A long flying body and short clawed arms offer immense reach and real grips, with awkward precision release and planted leverage.
species.rationale: Rayquaza's high-altitude flight and Air Lock support clean aerial tracking while its short grasping arms can high-point a football; long-body rush angles and coiling wraps are dangerous, but vast reach does not guarantee precise spirals or compact corner cuts.
species.synopsis: Rayquaza attacks with enormous aerial reach, short grasping claws and sweeping rush angles. Its long body and limited arm leverage make precise passing and compact turns less natural than sky-high catches.

species.name: Jirachi
species.canonicalInspiredRationale: Jirachi's protective wish lore and Serene Grace inspire rare bounded favorable breaks rather than guaranteed outcomes; Psychic supplies precise possession and a steel body withstands glancing contact, but a tiny frame cannot dominate a heavy block.
species.physicalScoutingNote: A tiny steel-bodied psychic with excellent control and anticipation, but almost no pushing mass or natural catch radius.
species.rationale: Jirachi's protective wish lore and Serene Grace inspire rare bounded favorable breaks rather than guaranteed outcomes; Psychic supplies precise possession and a steel body withstands glancing contact, but a tiny frame cannot dominate a heavy block.
species.synopsis: Jirachi pairs extraordinary anticipation with precise psychic possession and quick floating movement. Its tiny frame remains a major limitation in tackles, blocking and sustained contact despite its steel body.

species.name: Deoxys
species.canonicalInspiredRationale: Normal Deoxys can reconfigure flexible tentacles into hands, use Psychic for precision and analyze opponents with its crystalline brain; bounded Teleport recovery and limb feints aid coverage, but it does not borrow Defense Forme armor or Speed Forme statistics.
species.physicalScoutingNote: Normal-form tentacles reshape into grasping arms for elite control and fast cuts, but a fragile core limits heavy contact.
species.rationale: Normal Deoxys can reconfigure flexible tentacles into hands, use Psychic for precision and analyze opponents with its crystalline brain; bounded Teleport recovery and limb feints aid coverage, but it does not borrow Defense Forme armor or Speed Forme statistics.
species.synopsis: Deoxys reshapes flexible tentacles into grasping arms and combines rapid reads with precise psychic control. This normal form has a fragile core, so repeated collisions and heavy blocking remain costly.
